intro: Modbus on a serial cable. One master and up to 247 slaves share a two-wire RS-485 line. Only the master starts a conversation: it calls one slave by its address, and only that slave answers. A CRC at the end of each frame catches damaged bytes.

poll.title: Ask slave 1
poll.text: The data logger is the master. It asks slave 1, the inverter, for two input registers. Every device on the line hears the frame, but only slave 1 answers.

meter.title: Ask slave 2
meter.text: Next, the meter at address 2. Its power is a 32-bit float in two registers, high word first.

silent.title: No answer
silent.text: Slave 3 does not answer. The logger waits 1 second, asks once more, then marks it offline and moves on. It cannot tell why: no power, a broken wire and a wrong setting look the same.

broadcast.title: Broadcast
broadcast.text: The logger sends a power limit to address 0, a broadcast. Every slave acts on it and none answers, so the logger does not know who got it. The meter has no register 40201 and does nothing.

confirm.title: Read it back
confirm.text: The logger gives the slaves 200 ms to act, then reads the limit back from slave 1: 60 %. Slave 3 is still offline, so its limit is unknown.

frames.inv1-req: Slave 1: send me input registers 0 and 1
frames.meter-req: Slave 2: send me input registers 12 and 13
frames.inv2-req: Slave 3: send me input registers 0 and 1
frames.confirm-req: Slave 1: what is your power limit?

slave-0.name: Address 0
slave-0.note: A broadcast: every slave takes the frame, and none may answer.

slave-1.name: Address 1
slave-1.note: Slave 1, the inverter. Only it answers this frame.

fc03.name: Function 03
fc03.note: 0x03: read holding registers, where settings live.

fc04.name: Function 04
fc04.note: 0x04: read input registers, the values a device measures. They cannot be written.

addr-0.name: Address 0
addr-0.note: 0x0000: register 30001 in the manual. The wire counts from 0.

addr-12.name: Address 12
addr-12.note: 0x000C = 12: register 30013, the power at the grid point.

voltage.name: Register 30002
voltage.note: 0x0900 = 2304: grid voltage in steps of 0.1 V, so 230.4 V.

meter-power.name: Registers 30013–30014
meter-power.note: 0x45337800: a 32-bit float, high word first (ABCD). It is 2871.5 (W).

crc.name: CRC
crc.note: CRC-16 over all bytes before it, sent low byte first. A slave drops a frame whose CRC is wrong, and stays silent.

facts.standard: Modbus over Serial Line V1.02 (Modbus Organization, 2006)
facts.between: One master (logger, controller) → up to 247 slaves
facts.transport: RS-485: two data wires and a ground, up to about 1200 m
facts.frames: Address, function code, data, CRC-16. No start byte: silence separates frames.
facts.speed: At 9600 baud an 8-byte request takes 9.2 ms

tips: Every device on the line must use the same speed, parity and stop bits. One wrong setting looks just like a dead slave.
Put a 120 Ω resistor at each end of the line, not at every device. Missing or extra ones cause CRC errors that come and go.
Two devices with the same address answer at once and garble each other. Set each address before you connect the device.
If nothing answers at all, swap the two data wires. Vendors do not agree on which one is A and which is B.

timing.title: Frames and silences on the line, at 9600 baud
timing.note: Modbus RTU has no start or end byte. A frame is over when the line stays quiet for 3.5 characters: 4.0 ms at 9600 baud, with 11 bits per character. Above 19200 baud the gap is fixed at 1.75 ms. Inside a frame, a pause longer than 1.5 characters breaks the frame.

playground.file: The logger's setup for this line. Every slave on it must use the same speed and parity.
playground.baud: 9600 bits per second. Every device on the line must use the same speed.
playground.parity: 8E1: 8 data bits, even parity, 1 stop bit. The parity bit catches single bit errors. 8E1 is Modbus's default; many devices come set to 8N1.
playground.timeout: How long the logger waits for an answer before it gives up: 1 second.
playground.retries: Ask once more before marking a slave offline.
playground.after-broadcast: Nobody answers a broadcast, so the logger waits this long before the next frame.
playground.address: The slave's address, 1 to 247. Two devices must never share one.
playground.read: Function 04 from address 0: the wire address, not 30001.
playground.values: Register 30001 holds watts. 30002 holds tenths of a volt: 2304 is 230.4 V.
playground.limit: The power limit, a holding register. The broadcast writes it on both inverters.
playground.float: The meter's power: one 32-bit float in two registers, high word first.
